evidence: SOURCE: task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template tests/Dockerfile (diff empty; .dockerignore, test.sh, score.py, restart_mcp.py and environment/Dockerfile also identical), so nothing task-specific weakened it. It ships every component the row and quality-checks.md#22 require: (1) Node runtime - 'FROM node:22-bookworm-slim AS node-runtime' + 'COPY --from=node-runtime /usr/local /usr/local' gives node/npm on the python:3.12-slim base; NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules matches test.sh lines 104-111 env -i NODE_PATH. (2) App runtime deps - 'express@5.1.0' and 'better-sqlite3@12.4.1' installed globally, exactly the versions in solution/app/package.json and in the agent image environment/Dockerfile; the golden requires only express, better-sqlite3 and node built-ins (src/index.js:18, src/db.js:7, bootstrap.js node:http/node:worker_threads), and integration.md lines 3-4 / instruction.md line 13 restrict submissions to 'Express and better-sqlite3 ... and Node built-ins' and 'don't install packages', so the verifier image covers every dependency a conforming app may use. (3) Judge CLI - '@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281' (task.toml REWARDKIT_JUDGE=claude-code) plus '@openai/codex@0.151.0'. (4) Playwright MCP - '@playwright/mcp@0.0.79' provides the 'playwright-mcp' command used in all five judge.toml files (line 11). (5) Pinned browser - Chromium installed via the Playwright CLI bundled with that pinned MCP version into PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/playwright-browsers with --with-deps, symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium, which is the --executable-path in every judge.toml line 12. (6) RewardKit - 'pip3 install --no-cache-dir harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7' (pinned); the agents.py patch asserts its anchor string exists so a drifted wheel fails the build rather than silently misbehaving. (7) python3 for the restart server - python:3.12-slim provides /usr/local/bin/python3, the command in scored/functional/judge.toml line 17; util-linux supplies setpriv/setsid used by test.sh; procps present. 'COPY . /tests' with chmod go-rwx keeps tests inside the verifier image. RUNTIME (partial, hashes re-verified against raw-evidence-index.json and matching frozen solution hashes: server.js 4fc5d2c4..., index.js 708f94cb..., package.json 94261e4e..., solve.sh 1df2ed04...): workspace.cjs ran in image 'hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair', launched node /app/server.js with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (line 16) and drove Chromium through '/usr/local/lib/node_modules/@playwright/mcp/node_modules/playwright' with executablePath '/usr/local/bin/chromium' (lines 6, 276); results/workspace.json records 25/25 groups passed, page_errors [], and server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000' twice (initial start and restart). That measures the node runtime, the global express/better-sqlite3, the Playwright library and the Chromium binary in a verifier-built image. NOT MEASURED: the claude-code judge CLI, the playwright-mcp stdio server, rewardkit and restart_mcp.py were never exercised end to end - the raw-evidence-index scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent', and the cited image tag is not hash-bound to the frozen tests/Dockerfile bytes (template-identical, so likely but unproven). Adversarial probes: a broken app cannot exploit the image (the image adds no grading shortcut; tests are go-rwx and the app runs as uid 65534). A conforming alternative that might fail: an app using node:sqlite instead of better-sqlite3 depends on both images resolving the same floating node:22 tag minor (node:sqlite unflagged from 22.13) - but the brief explicitly names better-sqlite3 as the provided SQLite package, so this is a P3 latent note, not a defect. Base images are pinned by tag not digest (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim) and python:3.12-slim's Debian release can roll forward under 'playwright install --with-deps'; this is template-controlled, applies to every task, and the rubric's 'pinned' is satisfied by the pinned npm/pip/browser versions - recorded as a latent P3 note, not a task defect. Risk=true solely because the full configured verifier launch/grading record (judge CLI + rewardkit + playwright-mcp) required by REVIEW_POLICY 'Runtime and model evidence' is missing; source verdict is Pass, runtime is PARTIAL.
